svg.title: Crafting and trade and Dealerships and classes
svg.desc: Crafting and trade: One engine behind every crafting station (repairs, enhancements, leaderboards), a server-owned trade centre with restocks, and org-run black markets. Resources: skills_crafting v2.0.0, skills_vendors, reborn_orgs. Dealerships and classes: Orbit-camera showrooms, server-side purchases, weekly limited-stock rotations, test drives and auto-captured vehicle photos, graded by one class system. Resources: reborn_vehicleshop, reborn_vehicleclass v2.0.0.
